Actor.description: Who or what produced a piece of data.
Actor.title: Actor

EvidenceCertainty.description:
How solid is a given piece of editorial data.

Mirrors Beslut 23's required three-way split, plus an explicit
"unconfirmed" state so that uncertainty is a first-class value rather
than an absent field or a disguised default.
EvidenceCertainty.title: EvidenceCertainty

actor_id.description: Free identifier for the actor, e.g. a human's name/initials or an AI system+model name. None only if genuinely unrecorded.
actor_id.title: Actor Id

method.description: How the value was produced, e.g. 'manual_entry', 'fas_0a_analysis', 'fas_0b_analysis', 'ai_inference'.
method.title: Method

analysis_logic_version.description: Version identifier of whatever analysis logic produced an interpretation, distinct from schema_version. Required whenever created_by == AI_SYSTEM (see tests/test_relation_integrity.py).
analysis_logic_version.title: Analysis Logic Version

supporting_source_ids.description: SOURCE.source_id values that back this claim, if any. Empty list, not a guess, when nothing supports it yet.
supporting_source_ids.title: Supporting Source Ids

SeriesRole.description:
Beslut 17: Series must never be conflated with topic / territory / form.
This enum classifies WHAT KIND of editorial pillar a series is, so two
series that look similar structurally aren't assumed to behave alike.
SeriesRole.title: SeriesRole
